meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Money supply month by month since 1991: M3 and M1, their components, and their sources
meta.note: RBI DBIE Data Query tables BMC_M (broad money components, monthly) and MSS_M (sources of money stock, monthly), ₹ lakh crore, last reporting Friday of each month (dated to the month). Series marked 'including the HDFC merger' are RBI's figures from July 2023 that count HDFC Ltd's balance sheet inside the banking system; the plain series exclude it until they stop (time deposits and M3 in June 2025). The two are different rulers and are never joined.
